name: Vamp Assistant
subtitle: Native Mac control and Assistant sessions from iPhone and iPad
description: Official AltStore source for the Vamp Assistant iPhone and iPad companion.

apps.name: Vamp Assistant
apps.subtitle: Control your trusted Mac and continue Assistant sessions remotely.
apps.localizedDescription: Pair with Vamp Assistant on your Mac to continue sessions, approve requests, exchange files, stream and control the Mac, and securely unlock it through Tailscale.

versions.localizedDescription: Attach images from Photos or Files using the chat + menu. Images stay with saved drafts and queued follow-ups, and reach native vision models on Mac build 126. Includes the queued-message send button and recovery fixes.

Send a saved queued follow-up directly from its card, even with an empty composer. Paired with Mac build 125, follow-ups keep the current model running and drain automatically after interrupted turns. Retries preserve the saved message and do not enqueue duplicates.

Start a new chat with a message and an available model. Advanced options are collapsed. Unload the active Mac model from the model picker without deleting its download. Pair with Mac build 124 for the Huihui GGUF loading fix.
Add API keys from iPhone or iPad, browse compatible providers, configure a custom endpoint, and add model IDs when a provider does not list them.
Improves conversation Retry and recovery, composer accessibility and activity feedback, and the narrow-screen Sessions shortcut.

New dot-matrix app icon. Accessibility and pairing fixes: 44pt back control on the disconnected screen, pairing code dismisses the keypad so Connect is reachable, readable placeholders at large text sizes, and the session access keys now state the approval policy they actually apply.
Docked machined composer with recessed editor plate, bayed control rail, neutral dark chassis, direct Auto/Full mode toggles, and clearer bay separators.
Adds saved drafts and connection diagnostics; fixes Mac switching, notification routing, duplicate sends, pairing recovery, and large-text pairing layout.
Makes secure Mac unlock complete at the physical login window and adds richer remote settings, model selection, bot console, approval previews, and stream recovery.
Adds clearly visible Version and Build information on the pairing screen and in Settings, plus the secure Tailscale-only Mac unlock flow.
Previous sideloadable iPhone and iPad release.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant scans the one-time pairing QR code shown by your Mac.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant connects to Vamp Assistant running on your trusted Mac.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant can dictate text onto your Mac from the Control keyboard.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant turns on-device speech into keystrokes on your Mac.
